market_position: Niche digital product for solo fabricators, welders and small fabrication shops; not a generic quote template.

rules.distribution_priority: Gumroad direct sales plus free search/community/content distribution
rules.build_gate: No build until product specification and distribution test are documented.

product_spec.core_promise: Know your real shop rate, price fabrication work consistently, and see expected versus actual profit on every job.
product_spec.target_buyer: solo fabricators, welders, mobile welders and small fabrication shops

candidates.name: Fabrication Shop Profit & Quote System
candidates.reason: Proven paid demand, clear pricing pain, strong automation fit, and a differentiated profit-focused workflow instead of a generic quote sheet.

candidates.name: Welding Business Toolkit
candidates.reason: Strong paid demand but more crowded around broad all-in-one welding bundles.

candidates.name: CNC Feeds & Speeds Helper
candidates.reason: Clear technical problem and paid market, but higher accuracy/liability burden and stronger specialist incumbents.

candidates.name: Generic Manufacturing Job Costing Spreadsheet
candidates.reason: Demand exists, but generic positioning is easier to copy and price-competes with low-cost listings.

current_market_evidence.finding: Current 2026 listing offers a 5-tab welding/fabrication estimate calculator with materials, labour, markup, consumables, tax and client quote output; listed at £3.31 and shows 1 sale after about one month.

current_market_evidence.source: Etsy — Welding Shop Hourly Rate Calculator
current_market_evidence.finding: Current listing priced at $38.28; combines break-even/target shop rate, per-weld costing, quote builder, material price DB, job log and monthly P&L.
Current listing bundles fabrication quote calculation with materials, labour, overhead, profit, add-ons and a bonus hourly-rate calculator.
Current $4.99 welding estimator covers metal, consumables, labour, travel, equipment and markup.
Current quoting/job-costing software explicitly targets small shops still using calculators and spreadsheets, confirming the underlying business pain and willingness to evaluate quoting tools.
Current AI quoting software targets custom fabricators and CNC shops, indicating an active market for faster and more accurate quoting.
No monthly fee; direct-link sales currently incur 10% + $0.50, supporting an RM0-upfront storefront.

supply_demand_assessment.interpretation: Not the largest market and not low-competition. It is the strongest first-product fit under Leverage's RM0, near-zero-owner-work and repeatable-delivery constraints.

initial_channels: relevant communities where promotion is allowed
distribution_test.success_gate: Generate qualified traffic and at least one buyer before broad product expansion.

next_gate: Finalize workbook UX/content, quick-start guide, Gumroad listing copy, and first 10 organic distribution assets before full build release.
